mentions.name: TracklistFinder
mentions.description: This web app turns YouTube DJ sets into tracklists: paste a video link and it extracts the tracks with timestamps, then creates a Spotify playlist from them with one click. It is free, requires no account, offers festival collection pages (e.g., Amsterdam Dance Event, Awakenings, DGTL), provides an API for building on it, and has a browser extension planned to show tracklists directly on the YouTube page.
mentions.problem: After hearing a DJ set on YouTube, there was no easy way to listen to its tracks on-the-go or create a Spotify playlist from them.
mentions.audience: Music listeners who watch DJ sets on YouTube; also developers via its public API
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on TracklistFinder (https://www.tracklistfinder.com)

I watch a lot of DJ sets on YouTube and kept running into the same problem: I hear a DJ set I like but then I want to listen to it on-the-go, like on my phone or create a playlist on spotify with those tracks.

So I built this. You paste a YouTube link and it pulls out the tracks with timestamps. Then you can turn that into a Spotify playlist with one click.
